sentences.text: I.A.No.2333 of 2022 is an application filed by appellant - Sanjeev Burman seeking suspension of sentence and bail.

The case of the prosecution is that on 01.10.2020 at about 11.30 PM, the complainant Rajendra Dahiya was informed by one Deepak Burman on phone that at about 10.30 PM, his neighbour namely appellant Sanjeev Burman had attacked Rajni Burman and her husband with a Farsa and killed Rajni Burman.
When the complainant went there, he found Rajni Burman lying dead in front of the house of Ramkhilawan.

Thereafter, a case was registered in FIR 0223 of 2020 against the accused persons for offence punishable under Sections 302, 307 and 324 of the IPC and after investigation, offence under Section 25 of the Arms Act was added.

O n trial, accused No.1/appellant was convicted under Section 302 and 324 of the IPC and sentenced to R.I. for life with fine of Rs.500/- and R.I. for three years (on two counts) with fine of Rs.500/- respectively with default stipulations vide judgment dated 31.01.2022 passed by the Third Additional Sessions Judge, District Katni in Sessions Trial No.20 of 2021.

entities.text: Third Additional Sessions Judge, District Katni
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The accused No.2 and 3 were acquitted.
The accused No.1 has filed this appeal against the aforesaid judgment.
The plea of the appellant is that he has already undergone a custody of about three years and hence he is entitled to be released on bail.
That there is no material evidence to indicate that the appellant was responsible for the death of the deceased as well as for causing injuries to her and Sunil.
He prays that the jail sentence of the appellant be suspended and he be enlarged on bail.
The same is disputed by the learned Government Advocate.
On hearing learned counsels, we do not find any ground to entertain this application.
The medical report would indicate that the deceased sustained four injuries.
The injuries were caused on her neck, right forearm, left ulna and radius bone and left back.
As a result of which, Rajni had succumbed to the injuries.

So far as injured Sunil Sanjeev Burman vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 21 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/160705728/
1 is concerned, he had suffered injuries on left hand, left ear and left shoulder.

entities.text: Sunil Sanjeev Burman vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The material evidence would indicate that the injuries were caused on the vital organs of the body.
The recovery of the weapon has been made at the behest of the appellant himself.
That the motive as such has been established by the prosecution to the effect that a case of section 376 IPC was lodged by deceased Rajni against the appellant.
Due to this case being lodged against him, he had an enmity against her as well as against her husband and therefore, that was the motive.

In view of the evidence available on record with regard to the manner in which the offence was committed and the injuries that were caused by a deadly weapon on the vital organs of the deceased,
we do not find any ground to enlarge the appellant on bail.
Hence, I.A.No.2333 of 2022 is dismissed.

(RAVI MALIMATH)
